title: Concept: Central package version entry without a version
description: Directory.Packages.props declares a `PackageVersion` entry that declares no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: With central package management the version comes from this file only, so an empty entry leaves the restore to the feed's latest.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Directory.Packages.props (nuget).
risk: With central package management the version comes from this file only, so an empty entry leaves the restore to the feed's latest.
